source_identity_accuracy.definition: Declared document corroborated by exact identity in independently decoded official raw heading; not source completeness/legal currency.
source_identity_accuracy.uncertainty: Descriptive risk-enriched sample, not a population estimate. No global confidence interval.

text_fidelity_rate.definition: Sampled body is found in independently decoded raw with whitespace/case normalization and exact clean offsets. Does not certify omitted source text.
text_fidelity_rate.uncertainty: Descriptive risk-enriched sample, not a population estimate. No global confidence interval.

parser_error_rate.definition: Confirmed passage crosses a legal unit boundary; unflagged passages have not been certified error-free.
parser_error_rate.uncertainty: 12 confirmed defects; 188 UNKNOWN. 0.06 is a lower bound in this sample, not a corpus-wide error rate.

contamination_rate.definition: Confirmed passage crosses a legal unit boundary; unflagged passages have not been certified error-free.
contamination_rate.uncertainty: 12 confirmed defects; 188 UNKNOWN. 0.06 is a lower bound in this sample, not a corpus-wide error rate.

truncation_rate.definition: Missing substantive source text, beyond intentional physical segmentation.
truncation_rate.uncertainty: Not established by substring tests; all UNKNOWN. No zero-error claim.

article_locator_accuracy.definition: Article identity corroborated by source unit heading and reviewed body contradictions.
article_locator_accuracy.uncertainty: 128 supported, 1 confirmed false article locator (Ley137), 21 ambiguous/unverified; 50 decisions not applicable.

hierarchy_accuracy.definition: Semantic parent ancestry, beyond literal heading membership.
hierarchy_accuracy.uncertainty: 1 confirmed wrong ancestry from merged Ley137 units; 199 UNKNOWN. Mechanical membership was 197/200 but is not legal hierarchy accuracy.

structural_metadata_accuracy.definition: Correct structural identity of passage body, not merely internally consistent node IDs/offsets.
structural_metadata_accuracy.uncertainty: 12 confirmed structural-boundary defects; remaining 188 UNKNOWN. All 200 mechanical offsets/nodes are consistent, which is weaker.

canonical_document_accuracy.definition: Canonical document identity corroborated by declared metadata and official raw heading.
canonical_document_accuracy.uncertainty: Descriptive risk-enriched sample, not a population estimate. No global confidence interval.

canonical_fragment_accuracy.definition: Article-based fragment identity with corroborated locator; sections/ambiguous units remain unverified.
canonical_fragment_accuracy.uncertainty: 128 supported, Ley137 false fragment, 71 UNKNOWN. C355 collision found separately by census, outside passage sample.

canonical_collision_rate.definition: Confirmed cross-structural-unit collision groups / all canonical fragment groups; 990 same-unit multi-segment groups are not automatically collisions.
canonical_collision_rate.uncertainty: One confirmed collision under the cross-unit detector; not a proof that other semantic collisions cannot exist. 172 passages in three C355 sections.

provenance_complete_rate.definition: Matching raw/clean SHA256, official URL, HTTP200, TLS verified, acquisition timestamp and passage source hash.
provenance_complete_rate.uncertainty: Descriptive risk-enriched sample, not a population estimate. No global confidence interval.

verified_temporal_status_rate.definition: Source-supported non-unknown temporal assertions / all sample units.
verified_temporal_status_rate.uncertainty: 20 explicit historical blocks. 180 unknown are conservative valid outcomes, not errors. No current-law certification.

incorrect_temporal_assertion_rate.definition: Unsupported temporal assertions / units asserting a non-unknown temporal state.
incorrect_temporal_assertion_rate.uncertainty: All 20 historical assertions supported by publisher markers. Unknown assertions are excluded, not failures.

unknown_with_no_evidence_rate.definition: Conservative unknown temporal assertions / all units.
unknown_with_no_evidence_rate.uncertainty: Valid conservative behavior; not an error metric.

graph_grounding_precision.definition: Relation-specific endpoint, direction and subject support in the full evidence passage.
graph_grounding_precision.uncertainty: {'PASS': 89, 'UNKNOWN': 3, 'FAIL': 8}. Evaluated precision 0.917526; overall unknown remains explicit. Lexical co-occurrence alone is insufficient.

relation_type_accuracy.definition: Relation-specific endpoint, direction and subject support in the full evidence passage.
relation_type_accuracy.uncertainty: {'PASS': 89, 'UNKNOWN': 3, 'FAIL': 8}. Evaluated precision 0.917526; overall unknown remains explicit. Lexical co-occurrence alone is insufficient.
